# Find repeated patterns and anomalies in a time series

> Free matrix profile tool for time series anomaly detection and motif discovery. Paste or upload a CSV and find repeated patterns (motifs) and the most unusual stretches (discords) with the exact STOMP algorithm. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
